headline: Sun Pharma Q2 sales rise 11.8% to Rs 16,100 crore
hook: Strong domestic growth offsets US sales dip
summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries reported an 11.8% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 sales to ₹16,100 crore, alongside an adjusted net profit of ₹3,162 crore. India formulation sales grew 17.3% to ₹5,552.3 crore, while US formulation sales declined 8.2% to $455 million. EBITDA increased 4.8% to ₹4,743.9 crore with a 29.3% margin, and regulatory approvals for the Organon acquisition were secured in most regions. Indian retail investors tracking pharma heavyweights can gauge domestic healthcare demand strength against US market headwinds.
why_it_matters: Domestic demand props up earnings despite US market headwinds
winners_losers: Domestic pharma players gain / US-heavy exporters hurt

Indian retail investors holding the pharma major face near-term volatility driven by analyst estimate revisions.
